text:
maria: starting config-only deploy now -> routing limits + timeout tweak + batching soft cap. Deploy bot: https://deploys.redwood.internal/7212341234 :deploy:
maria: landing window 20:00-21:00 PT, canary routed 1% traffic to dedicated nodes. keeping model pinned to v2.3.1 for safety.
deploy-bot: rollout started: stage=canary pct=1 target=dedicated-gpu-pool-3 config=cfg/2026-03-21/small-batching-timeout.json
ben: quick q — what's the timeout change? and batch size?
maria: timeout 1200ms -> 1000ms, batch_size max 64 -> 48, batching window 20ms -> 15ms. just config, no binary.
anya: watching for kv-cache pressure; last time reducing window spiked small tail latencies. set observability alert for p99 +500ms.
dino: can we route 1% to a geo subset (us-west only)? less blast radius.
maria: yes will scope canary to us-west-2 tenants only. updated config snippet below:
```yaml
routing:
  scope: us-west-2
limits:
  max_batch_size: 48
  request_timeout_ms: 1000
batching_window_ms: 15
```
deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2, pct=1, started health checks.
infra-observability-bot: metrics stream -> canary: p50=120ms p95=310ms p99=520ms errors=0.02% token_cost_delta=-0.4%
ben: p99 520 looks okay given last baseline 515. keep an eye.
anya: if errors >0.5% or p99 >700ms for 5m, we rollback. plz set auto-rollback rule.
maria: set rule: rollback_if(errors_pct>0.5, p99_increase>35% over baseline, sustained 5m). adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/config-rollbacks
deploy-bot: auto-rollback rule registered.
infra-observability-bot: alerting config applied for route: /v1/generate, notify: #eng-oncall + pager.
dino: also recommend keeping model pinned v2.3.1 for next 24h; if we see no degradations we'll unpin at +24h.
maria: agreed. will hold unpin for 24h.
ben: small nit — release notes? add short blurb about reduced timeout/batch for cost + latency tradeoff.
maria: added: "Config-only: tighten request timeout to 1000ms, decrease max_batch_size to 48, shorten batching window to 15ms. Scoped canary to us-west-2. Auto-rollback on error spike or p99 regression."
deploy-bot: canary healthy at 1% after 10m. metrics: p95 delta +2ms, errors stable. Proceeding to 5% in 10m unless objections.
anya: no objections. monitoring closely.
dino: thumbs up from infra.
maria: thanks — will post final when fully rolled to production or if rollback triggered. :thumbsup:
